text:
Maya: Quick kickoff — HaloEdge wants a joint pilot using Dedicated pools. We need a tech handoff, security checklist, and a scoped pricing sketch. Can infra + solutions sync today?
Josh: On it. What traffic shape are we planning for? QPS, sequence lengths?
Maya: HaloEdge reported ~25 reqs/sec steady, bursts to ~200 for short windows. Typical seq ~512 tokens; embeddings workload ~30k calls/month.
Evan: For bursts we'll rely on burst buckets on Dedicated. Also need SAML metadata + SCIM for provisioning. Who is owning SSO exchange?
Rachel: HaloEdge will own IdP config but asked for our metadata and attribute map. They also asked for SCIM write scope.
Josh: Networking question — do they require private connectivity (VPC peering / PrivateLink) or is NAT egress ok? They flagged firewall policies.
Maya: They prefer VPC peering but can accept NAT with static egress IPs. Security also requested KMS integration details and audit log retention.
ops-bot: provisioning-sandbox #3942 started (commit abc123) — estimated 18m to provision sandbox tenant 
Evan: Pricing note: customer asked commit vs on-demand. Suggest 3-month pilot credit + hard usage cap to cap exposure. Sales — can you lead on LOI?
Sam: I can. Need a quick per-token estimate for mixed generation + embeddings at these volumes to include in the LOI.
Josh: Back-of-envelope: gen at seq=512, 25 qps → ~3.5M tokens/day. With batching/kv-caching we can cut token work ~30–45% depending on prompt templates. I'll put a spreadsheet together.
Maya: Infra, can you produce a minimal egress/CIDR list and ports for their firewall so they can open access? Put it in the runbook snippet.
Josh: Pasted CIDRs for now:
```
34.120.10.0/24
34.120.11.0/24
443/TCP only
```
Evan: For pilot reliability, plan: pin model to rwd-1.2; fallback rwd-1.1 for cost-sensitive spikes. We'll add policy in the canary rollout.
Maya: Good. Also need a short onboarding runbook for HaloEdge devs (tenant provisioning, entitlements, test keys). Can solutions produce a 1-pager?
Rachel: Uploading runbook now: https://redwood.example/runbooks/haloedge-kickstart (private link)
Maya: Scheduling — propose 30m tech sync tomorrow 10:00am PT with HaloEdge infra + our infra/solutions. @Sam please invite Legal for SCIM/KMS clause review and Security for audit retention discussion.
Sam: Added Legal and Security to the invite. Draft LOI in next 2 hrs.
Evan: One potential blocker — HaloEdge CI runners rotate IPs weekly. We need to confirm support for ephemeral allowlists or a proxy approach.
Rachel: I'll check with their infra lead and report back in this thread.
Maya: Next steps summary: infra → sandbox + CIDR runbook; solutions → 1-pager + canary model policy; sales → LOI + pricing sheet; security/legal → scoping for SCIM/KMS/audit. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:
Josh: Noted. I'll upload the pricing spreadsheet when ready.
Rachel: Followed up with HaloEdge infra — they can provide a static egress pool if needed, confirming details.
Maya: Thanks everyone — great momentum.
